meanings.note: ничего не осталось = there's nothing left

Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to remain, to be left', paired with 'оставаться'.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.en: to cook, to make (food), to prepare
meanings.note: Takes accusative. Prefix 'при-' indicates approaching, attachment, or slight degree of action (stem 'готовить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to prepare, to cook, to make', paired with 'готовить'.

meanings.note: Прямо так = just like that. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.en: dear, darling, my friend (in address: родной мой)
meanings.note: Often used ironically. Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('native, own; dear, darling').
родной брат = full brother; родной город = hometown

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'делать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to do, to make', paired with 'делать'.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: 'сейчас буду' = I'll be right there
Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ейчас').

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: Intransitive, reflexive. Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'ломаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to break down, get broken', paired with 'ломаться'.

examples.trans: Yesterday the washing machine broke down.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'лушаться'). Used in Russian as an imperfective verb expressing ongoing, habitual, or repeated action meaning 'to obey', forming an aspectual pair with 'послушаться'. The reflexive suffix '-ся'/'-сь' makes the action intransitive, reciprocal, or directed at the subject.

examples.trans: Understood, chef! I will find the knife.

examples.text: Слушаюсь, шеф, я сделаю всё моментально.
